program='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter, deque
    counts = Counter(c for row in grid for c in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    frame = next(c for c in counts if c != bg and counts[c] > 4)
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); objects=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != frame or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            for y,x in q:
                cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==frame and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            objects.append(cells)
    boxes=[]
    for cells in objects:
        rs=[x[0] for x in cells]; cs=[x[1] for x in cells]
        boxes.append((min(rs),min(cs),max(rs)+1,max(cs)+1))
    boxes.sort(key=lambda b:(b[0],b[1]))
    n=max(b[2]-b[0] for b in boxes)
    out=[[frame]*n for _ in range(n)]
    shifts=[0]*len(boxes)
    # With several patterns, equal starting rows are staggered in reading order.
    if len(boxes)>2:
        used=set()
        for i,(r0,c0,r1,c1) in enumerate(boxes):
            starts=[r-r0 for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,frame)]
            if starts:
                s=min(starts)
                while s+shifts[i] in used: shifts[i]+=1
                used.add(s+shifts[i])
    for i,(r0,c0,r1,c1) in enumerate(boxes):
        marks=[(r-r0,c-c0,grid[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,frame)]
        for r,c,v in marks:
            rr=r+shifts[i]
            cc=c
            # Move a mark left only to avoid overwriting an earlier mark.
            while 0<cc<n-1 and out[rr][cc]!=frame: cc-=1
            if 0<rr<n-1 and 0<cc<n-1: out[rr][cc]=v
    return out
'''
ns={};exec(program,ns)
for i,p in enumerate(pairs):
